name: "Free Unsigned iOS Export"
on: [push, workflow_dispatch]

jobs:
  build-ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest # Uses GitHub's free Mac minutes
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Export Xcode Project via Godot
        uses: dulvui/godot4-ios-export@v1
        with:
          godot-version: 4.6.3.stable # Match your exact version

      - name: Compress Unsigned App Directory
        run: |
          # Compress the folder instead of building a restricted .ipa
          mkdir -p build
          mv ios/ build/
          zip -r ios_xcode_project.zip build/

      - name: Upload Exported Files to GitHub
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: godot-ios-project
          path: ios_xcode_project.zip
